The 20 GB boot disk is filling. Most likely cause is container logs; the compose files cap json-file at 10m x 3 per container, so growth beyond that is images or the repo checkout.

Note: these boot disks hold docker's resolved container environment at /var/lib/docker/containers/<id>/config.v2.json, which contains secret values. Do NOT snapshot or image them, and do not copy them off the host when debugging a disk-full condition.
